name: Magnetic Project Index Pill
description: Engineer an ergonomic floating index pill that subtly shifts position when the cursor enters within a 120px threshold radius. Apply dampened spring physics with a spring constant of 0.28 and mass damping of 0.85, gently returning to origin on mouse exit.
designPhilosophy: Engineer an ergonomic floating index pill that subtly shifts position when the cursor enters within a 120px threshold radius
implementationApproach: Provide full keyboard Tab focus with visible high-contrast hairline focus rings for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
performanceConsiderations: Utilize translate3d, will-change sparingly, and clamp animation timelines under 600ms.
accessibilityRequirements: Provide prefers-reduced-motion override and ensure WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard focus visibility.
